title.narrative: Project- Enhancing the Resilience of Area C

description.narrative: Comet-ME functions in the day-to-day as a mini-utility company for off-grid communities in Area C, ensuring the sustainability of all its past installations through reliable maintenance and management of energy systems. The organisation views their programmes as ongoing partnerships with the communities they serve, rather than finite projects. Upon completion of the installation phase, the infrastructure becomes the community’s property, while service contracts establish clear rights and responsibilities for both users and Comet-ME. This ensures mutual accountability and long-term collaboration. Comet ME implements a bill-payment system that is designed to be both affordable and equitable, with users paying the same rate for energy they would pay were they connected to the electricity grid. This contributes to covering a growing share of Comet-ME’s maintenance costs, ensuring the sustainability of the infrastructure for years to come. The new smart metering system proposed in this project embodies this philosophy, promoting transparency and accountability in energy usage and strengthening community engagement. Reporting of COMET-ME projects provides an overview of breakdown of Number of Women, Children and Households served by the project.
